question: In race ID 15, what is the name of the constructor that earned the most points?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM constructorResults AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T2.constructorId = T1.constructorId WHERE T1.raceId = 15 ORDER BY T1.points DESC LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT c.name 
FROM constructorResults cr 
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId 
WHERE cr.raceId = 15 
ORDER BY cr.points DESC 
LIMIT 1

question: Which driver had the longest pit stop, and at which race did it occur?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.milliseconds, T1.forename, T1.surname, T3.name FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN pitStops AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId ORDER BY T2.milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.name 
FROM pitStops ps 
JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId 
JOIN races r ON ps.raceId = r.raceId 
WHERE ps.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitStops)

turns.hint: SELECT 절의 가장 앞에 피트 스탑 시간(milliseconds)을 추가하여 피트 스탑 시간, 이름(forename), 성(surname), 레이스 이름(name) 순서로 출력되도록 변경하세요.
turns.sql:
SELECT ps.milliseconds, d.forename, d.surname, r.name 
FROM pitStops ps 
JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId 
JOIN races r ON ps.raceId = r.raceId 
WHERE ps.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitStops)

question: How many German drivers recorded a lap time below 01:40.00?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.driverId) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.nationality = 'German' AND (CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) + CAST(SUBSTR(T2.time, 7, 2) AS REAL) / 1000) < 100

turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) 
FROM drivers d 
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId 
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' 
AND (CAST(SUBSTR(lt.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(lt.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER)) < 100

question: Among drivers who have a driver standings entry, what are the driver reference, racing code, and date of the race associated with the oldest driver?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.driverRef, T1.code, T3.date FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId ORDER BY JULIANDAY(T1.dob) ASC LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT d.driverRef, d.code, r.date 
FROM drivers d 
JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId 
JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId 
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MIN(dob) FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL) 
LIMIT 1

turns.hint: 서브쿼리로 전체 드라이버 대상 최연장자 생년월일을 구하는 대신, 테이블 조인 후 생년월일(dob)을 일자 단위 변환 함수인 JULIANDAY(dob) 기준으로 오름차순 정렬하여 상위 1건만 조회(LIMIT 1)하도록 수정하세요.
turns.sql:
SELECT d.driverRef, d.code, r.date 
FROM drivers d 
JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId 
JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId 
ORDER BY JULIANDAY(d.dob) ASC 
LIMIT 1

question: Formula 1 result records에서 가장 빠른 패스트랩을 기록한 상위 15명의 드라이버 전체 이름을 알려주세요.
gold_sql: WITH fastest_lap_times_in_seconds AS (SELECT driverId, (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') + 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds FROM results) SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.driverId FROM (SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM fastest_lap_times_in_seconds GROUP BY driverId) AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId ORDER BY T1.min_time_in_seconds ASC LIMIT 15

turns.sql:
WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT driverId, 
           (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) <> '' 
                 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
                 ELSE 0 END + 
            CASE WHEN SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) <> '' 
                 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) 
                 ELSE 0 END + 
            CASE WHEN SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') + 1) <> '' 
                 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds 
    FROM results 
    WHERE fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
) 
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name 
FROM lap_times_in_seconds AS lt 
JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId 
JOIN (SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time 
      FROM lap_times_in_seconds 
      GROUP BY driverId) AS min_times ON lt.driverId = min_times.driverId 
ORDER BY min_times.min_time ASC 
LIMIT 15

turns.hint: SELECT 절에서 드라이버 이름을 하나로 문자열 연결하지 말고 forename, surname, driverId를 각각 별도의 컬럼으로 출력하도록 변경하세요. 또한, CTE 내에서 WHERE fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL 조건을 제거하고, 드라이버별 최소 랩 타임(MIN)을 집계한 서브쿼리와 drivers 테이블을 직접 조인하여 결과를 구하도록 수정해 보세요.
turns.sql:
WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT driverId, 
           (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) <> '' 
                 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
                 ELSE 0 END + 
            CASE WHEN SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) <> '' 
                 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) 
                 ELSE 0 END + 
            CASE WHEN SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') + 1) <> '' 
                 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds 
    FROM results
) 
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, lt.driverId 
FROM (SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time 
      FROM lap_times_in_seconds 
      GROUP BY driverId) AS lt 
JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId 
ORDER BY lt.min_time ASC 
LIMIT 15

question: Since the 2005 season, what percentage of race standings had Alonso placed anywhere other than first?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.position <> 1 THEN T2.position END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.driverStandingsId) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.surname = 'Alonso' AND T1.year >= 2005

turns.sql:
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN r.position != 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.surname = 'Alonso' AND ra.year >= 2005

turns.hint: 레이스 순위 정보는 results 테이블이 아닌 driverStandings 테이블을 참조해야 합니다. results 대신 driverStandings 테이블을 조인하고, position이 1이 아닌 경우의 수를 전체 driverStandingsId 건수로 나누어 백분율을 계산하도록 쿼리를 수정해 보세요.
turns.sql:
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN ds.position != 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM driverStandings ds
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.surname = 'Alonso' AND r.year >= 2005

question: Which driver's first and last name belongs to the competitor with the fastest Q2 time at the 2012 race held at Circuit de Catalunya?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T1.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE q2 IS NOT NULL AND T3.year = 2012 AND T3.circuitId IN (SELECT circuitId FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Circuit de Catalunya') ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(q2, 1, INSTR(q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(q2, INSTR(q2, ':') + 1, INSTR(q2, '.') - INSTR(q2, ':') - 1) AS REAL) + CAST(SUBSTR(q2, INSTR(q2, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 ASC LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT d.forename, d.surname 
FROM qualifying q 
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId 
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId 
WHERE r.year = 2012 AND q.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = r.raceId) 
LIMIT 1

turns.hint: circuits 테이블을 조인하여 서킷 이름이 'Circuit de Catalunya'인 조건을 추가하고, q2가 NULL이 아닌 데이터를 필터링하세요. 또한 서브쿼리 대신 q2 시간 문자열을 초 단위로 변환하여 오름차순 정렬(ORDER BY ... ASC LIMIT 1)하는 방식으로 가장 빠른 드라이버를 조회하도록 수정하세요.
turns.sql:
SELECT d.forename, d.surname 
FROM qualifying q 
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId 
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId 
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId 
WHERE r.year = 2012 AND c.name = 'Circuit de Catalunya' AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY (CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, 1, INSTR(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, INSTR(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) ASC 
LIMIT 1

question: Which British driver is the youngest, and how old is that driver?
gold_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', dob), forename, surname FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'British' ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT forename, surname, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', dob)) AS age
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'British'
ORDER BY dob DESC
LIMIT 1

turns.hint: `SELECT` 절의 컬럼 순서를 나이 계산식, 드라이버 이름(`forename`), 성(`surname`) 순으로 변경하고, 나이를 계산할 때는 `'now'` 대신 `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`를 활용하여 생년월일(`dob`)과의 연도 차이를 구하도록 수정하세요.
turns.sql:
SELECT (strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', dob)) AS age, forename, surname
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'British'
ORDER BY dob DESC
LIMIT 1

question: For each season from 1990 onward, what is the average finishing time in seconds for drivers who placed second?
gold_sql: WITH time_in_seconds AS ( SELECT T2.year, T2.raceId, T1.positionOrder, CASE WHEN T1.positionOrder = 2 THEN (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 1, 1) AS REAL) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 3, 2) AS REAL) * 60) + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 6, 2) AS REAL) + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 9) AS REAL) / 1000 ELSE 0 END AS time_seconds FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.time IS NOT NULL ), second_place_time AS ( SELECT year, raceId, time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionOrder = 2 ) SELECT year, AVG(time_seconds) FROM second_place_time WHERE year >= 1990 GROUP BY year HAVING AVG(time_seconds) IS NOT NULL

turns.sql:
WITH time_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT T2.year, T1.positionOrder, 
    CASE 
        WHEN T1.positionOrder = 2 THEN 
            (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 1, 2) AS REAL) * 3600) + 
            (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 4, 2) AS REAL) * 60) + 
            CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 7, 2) AS REAL) + 
            CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 10) AS REAL) / 1000 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS time_seconds 
    FROM results AS T1 
    INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId 
    WHERE T1.time IS NOT NULL 
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_seconds) AS average_time_seconds 
FROM time_in_seconds 
WHERE year >= 1990 AND positionOrder = 2 
GROUP BY year 
HAVING AVG(time_seconds) IS NOT NULL

turns.hint: `time` 컬럼의 시간 문자열에서 시, 분, 초, 밀리초를 추출할 때 인덱스 위치를 각각 1번째 1글자, 3번째 2글자, 6번째 2글자, 9번째 이후 글자로 변경(`SUBSTR(T1.time, 1, 1)`, `SUBSTR(T1.time, 3, 2)`, `SUBSTR(T1.time, 6, 2)`, `SUBSTR(T1.time, 9)`)하여 초 단위 변환을 수행하세요. 또한 2위(`positionOrder = 2`) 기록을 별도로 필터링한 후 연도(`year`)별 평균 시간을 구하도록 쿼리를 수정하세요.
turns.sql:
WITH time_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT T2.year, 
    (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 1, 1) AS REAL) * 3600) + 
    (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 3, 2) AS REAL) * 60) + 
    CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 6, 2) AS REAL) + 
    CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 9) AS REAL) / 1000 AS time_seconds 
    FROM results AS T1 
    INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId 
    WHERE T1.time IS NOT NULL AND T1.positionOrder = 2
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_seconds) AS average_time_seconds 
FROM time_in_seconds 
WHERE year >= 1990 
GROUP BY year 
HAVING AVG(time_seconds) IS NOT NULL

question: In the Monaco Grand Prix, how many engine failures were recorded for the driver with the most such failures?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.driverId) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN status AS T3 ON T1.statusId = T3.statusId WHERE T3.statusId = 5 AND T2.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' GROUP BY T1.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(T1.driverId) DESC LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(r.statusId) AS engine_failures
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.statusId = 5
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY engine_failures DESC
LIMIT 1

turns.hint: `SELECT` 절에서 드라이버 이름(`forename`, `surname`)은 제외하고 가장 많은 엔진 결함 횟수(`COUNT(driverId)`)만 출력하도록 변경하세요. 또한, `status` 테이블을 조인하고 드라이버(`driverId`)별로 그룹화한 뒤, 결함 횟수 기준 내림차순 정렬하여 상위 1건만 조회(`LIMIT 1`)하도록 수정하세요.
turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(r.driverId) AS engine_failures
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.statusId = 5
GROUP BY r.driverId
ORDER BY engine_failures DESC
LIMIT 1

question: What is the fastest lap record achieved at a circuit located in Germany?
gold_sql: WITH fastest_lap_times AS (SELECT T1.raceId, T1.FastestLapTime, (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds FROM results AS T1 WHERE T1.FastestLapTime IS NOT NULL) SELECT T1.FastestLapTime AS lap_record FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_times.time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM fastest_lap_times INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON fastest_lap_times.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Germany') AS T4 ON (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) = T4.min_time_in_seconds LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
WITH fastest_lap_times AS (
    SELECT T1.raceId, T1.FastestLapTime, 
           (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + 
           (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + 
           (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) as time_in_seconds 
    FROM results AS T1 
    WHERE T1.FastestLapTime IS NOT NULL 
) 
SELECT T1.FastestLapTime as lap_record 
FROM results AS T1 
INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId 
INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 on T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId 
INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_times.time_in_seconds) as min_time_in_seconds 
            FROM fastest_lap_times 
            INNER JOIN races AS T2 on fastest_lap_times.raceId = T2.raceId 
            INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 on T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId 
            WHERE T3.country = 'Germany') AS T4 
ON (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + 
   (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + 
   (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) = T4.min_time_in_seconds 
LIMIT 1

question: By what percentage was the race winner quicker than the last driver to finish the 2016 Monaco Grand Prix?
gold_sql: WITH time_in_seconds AS ( SELECT T1.positionOrder, CASE WHEN T1.positionOrder = 1 THEN (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 1, 1) AS REAL) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 3, 2) AS REAL) * 60) + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 6) AS REAL) ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 2) AS REAL) END AS time_seconds FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND T1.time IS NOT NULL AND T2.year = 2016 ), champion_time AS ( SELECT time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionOrder = 1), last_driver_incremental AS ( SELECT time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionOrder = (SELECT MAX(positionOrder) FROM time_in_seconds) ) SELECT (CAST((SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) AS REAL) * 100) / (SELECT time_seconds + (SELECT time_seconds FROM last_driver_incremental) FROM champion_time)

turns.sql:
SELECT 
    ((lastFinisher.timeGap / (winner.time + lastFinisher.timeGap)) * 100) AS percentage_quicker
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        r.time AS time, 
        r.time - (SELECT MIN(r2.time) FROM results r2 WHERE r2.raceId = r.raceId AND r2.position IS NOT NULL) AS timeGap
     FROM 
        results r 
     JOIN 
        races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
     WHERE 
        ra.year = 2016 AND ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.position IS NOT NULL 
     ORDER BY 
        r.position DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS lastFinisher,
    (SELECT 
        r.time 
     FROM 
        results r 
     JOIN 
        races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
     WHERE 
        ra.year = 2016 AND ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.position = 1) AS winner

turns.hint: CTE를 활용해 우승자(`positionOrder = 1`)의 완주 시간 문자열('H:MM:SS')을 초 단위로 변환하고, 최하위 완주자(`MAX(positionOrder)`)의 격차 시간 문자열('+초')에서 숫자를 추출해 초 단위로 변환하세요. 그 후 '최하위 완주자 격차 시간 * 100 / (우승자 완주 시간 + 최하위 완주자 격차 시간)' 공식을 적용해 백분율을 계산하도록 수정하세요.
turns.sql:
WITH Winner AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, ':', INSTR(time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':', INSTR(time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS INTEGER) AS total_time_seconds
    FROM 
        results r
    JOIN 
        races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE 
        ra.year = 2016 AND ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.positionOrder = 1
),
LastFinisher AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(MAX(time), 2) AS INTEGER) AS time_gap_seconds
    FROM 
        results r
    JOIN 
        races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE 
        ra.year = 2016 AND ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.positionOrder = (SELECT MAX(positionOrder) FROM results WHERE raceId = r.raceId)
)
SELECT 
    (LastFinisher.time_gap_seconds * 100.0 / (Winner.total_time_seconds + LastFinisher.time_gap_seconds)) AS percentage_quicker
FROM 
    Winner, LastFinisher

turns.hint: 하나의 CTE에서 `time IS NOT NULL` 조건으로 완주자 데이터를 필터링한 후, `positionOrder = 1`인 우승자는 `SUBSTR` 함수를 사용해 인덱스 위치(1번째 1글자, 3번째 2글자, 6번째 이후)로 시·분·초를 분리해 초 단위를 구하고 그 외 선수는 2번째 글자부터 추출해 초 단위 시간(`time_seconds`)을 변환하세요. 그 다음 우승자 시간과 최하위 완주자(`MAX(positionOrder)`)의 격차 시간을 각각 구해 `(최하위 완주자 격차 시간 * 100) / (우승자 시간 + 최하위 완주자 격차 시간)`으로 비율을 구하도록 쿼리를 수정하세요.
turns.sql:
WITH Finishers AS (
    SELECT 
        r.time,
        r.positionOrder,
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 6) AS INTEGER) AS time_seconds
    FROM 
        results r
    JOIN 
        races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE 
        ra.year = 2016 AND ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    (lastFinisher.time_gap_seconds * 100.0 / (winner.total_time_seconds + lastFinisher.time_gap_seconds)) AS percentage_quicker
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        time_seconds AS total_time_seconds
     FROM 
        Finishers
     WHERE 
        positionOrder = 1) AS winner,
    (SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(MAX(time), 2) AS INTEGER) AS time_gap_seconds
     FROM 
        Finishers
     WHERE 
        positionOrder = (SELECT MAX(positionOrder) FROM Finishers)) AS lastFinisher

question: In races 853 and 854, by what percentage was Lewis Hamilton's fastest-lap speed in race 853 higher than in race 854?
gold_sql: SELECT (SUM(IIF(T2.raceId = 853, T2.fastestLapSpeed, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.raceId = 854, T2.fastestLapSpeed, 0))) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T2.raceId = 853, T2.fastestLapSpeed, 0)) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.forename = 'Lewis' AND T1.surname = 'Hamilton'

turns.sql:
SELECT (CAST((SELECT lt1.milliseconds FROM lapTimes lt1 
              JOIN results r1 ON lt1.raceId = r1.raceId 
              JOIN drivers d1 ON r1.driverId = d1.driverId 
              WHERE r1.raceId = 853 AND d1.forename = 'Lewis' AND d1.surname = 'Hamilton') AS REAL) - 
        CAST((SELECT lt2.milliseconds FROM lapTimes lt2 
              JOIN results r2 ON lt2.raceId = r2.raceId 
              JOIN drivers d2 ON r2.driverId = d2.driverId 
              WHERE r2.raceId = 854 AND d2.forename = 'Lewis' AND d2.surname = 'Hamilton') AS REAL)) * 100.0 / 
        CAST((SELECT lt1.milliseconds FROM lapTimes lt1 
              JOIN results r1 ON lt1.raceId = r1.raceId 
              JOIN drivers d1 ON r1.driverId = d1.driverId 
              WHERE r1.raceId = 853 AND d1.forename = 'Lewis' AND d1.surname = 'Hamilton') AS REAL) AS percentage_difference

turns.hint: `lapTimes` 테이블과 `milliseconds` 컬럼 대신 `results` 테이블의 `fastestLapSpeed` 컬럼을 사용해야 합니다. `drivers`와 `results` 테이블만 조인한 후, `IIF` 조건식을 활용해 raceId가 853일 때와 854일 때의 `fastestLapSpeed`를 각각 구하여 백분율 공식 `(853속도 - 854속도) * 100 / 853속도`를 적용하도록 쿼리를 수정하세요.
turns.sql:
SELECT IIF(fastestLapSpeed_853 IS NOT NULL AND fastestLapSpeed_854 IS NOT NULL, 
           (fastestLapSpeed_853 - fastestLapSpeed_854) * 100.0 / fastestLapSpeed_853, 
           NULL) AS percentage_difference
FROM (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM results WHERE raceId = 853 AND driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton')) AS fastestLapSpeed_853,
        (SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM results WHERE raceId = 854 AND driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton')) AS fastestLapSpeed_854
) AS speeds

question: 2012년 모나코 그랑프리에서 기록된 완주 시간을 가진 드라이버는 몇 명인가요?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2012 AND T1.time IS NOT NULL

turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM results AS r 
JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
WHERE ra.year = 2012 AND ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.time IS NOT NULL

question: What was the mean lap time recorded by Sebastian Vettel at the 2010 Bahrain Grand Prix?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.milliseconds) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Sebastian' AND T3.surname = 'Vettel' AND T1.year = 2010 AND T1.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix'

turns.sql:
SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) 
FROM lapTimes lt 
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId 
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId 
WHERE d.forename = 'Sebastian' AND d.surname = 'Vettel' 
AND r.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' 
AND r.year = 2010

question: What is the racing number of the driver who recorded a 1:24 Q3 time in qualifying for race number 904?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.number FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 904 AND T1.q3 LIKE '1:24%'

turns.sql: SELECT d.number FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 904 AND q.q3 LIKE '1:24%'
